items:
Relax on the sugar-white sand from this 3-story, beachfront townhome in Sea Haunts on 30A. Enjoy Gulf-front balconies, a private boardwalk to the beach, a large community pool with hot tub, and family-friendly space for up to 10 guests.

Quick facts
Sleeps 10: King master, 2 queen bedrooms, kids bunk room (sleeps 4)
3 stories with multiple Gulf-view balconies and a ground-floor private patio
Private boardwalk to the beach; community pool, hot tub and grill area
Well-equipped kitchen, dining area, and living room
Kids bunk room includes TV; beach toy box provided

Layout highlights
Top floor: Primary with king bed, private balcony and soothing Gulf sounds; nearby queen bedroom shares a bath with primary
Main floor: Open living/dining/kitchen, half bath, balcony with sunset views
Bottom floor: Bunk room (sleeps 4) and third queen bedroom with patio; shared full bath

Location perks
On scenic Highway 30A — minutes to Seaside, Grayton Beach, Rosemary Beach and local dining
Walkable to fun restaurants like Shunk Gulley, the Perfect Pig, and Pizza by the Sea at Gulf Place
Easy bike access with path along 30A and local rental delivery available
Short drive to shopping, family activities and nightlife in Destin and Sandestin

Why guests book
Direct beachfront access, multiple outdoor living spaces, family amenities (kids’ bunk room, games, beach toy box), and a peaceful 30A location make this an ideal spot for multi-gen families or groups.

Located in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on the beach. While the natural beauty of Blue Mountain Beach and Grayton Beach State Park can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Sirens at the Beach are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and kayaking nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling and ecotours.
